research_situations: a declared variable list needs standard summary statistics retained as an active estpost result
selection_conditions: the analysis sample and variable list are already fixed
a downstream esttab consumer explicitly accepts an active estpost result rather than a shared .dta summary artifact
required_changes: replace the declared variable list and any already approved sample restriction only
tradeoffs: keeps the statistic source in an active result
does not create the named summary .dta required when a table and figure must share a durable dataset
reusable_core: 선언된 변수 목록의 summarize 결과를 active estpost 상태로 남긴다.
generality_rationale_ko: 표본과 변수 목록만 바꾸는 단일 명령이며, durable summary dataset을 요구하는 작업과 명확히 분리한다.
review_notes: Use only for an estpost-aware table consumer; do not substitute it for a producer shared by a table and a figure.

research_situations: a declared variable list needs detailed percentile statistics in an active estpost result
selection_conditions: the analysis sample, variables, and need for detailed statistics are declared
a downstream consumer is explicitly compatible with the active estpost result
required_changes: replace the declared variable list and approved sample restriction only
tradeoffs: adds detailed distribution statistics
has a wider result surface than a basic mean/sd/count table

produces: one active detailed estpost summary result

variable_characteristics: numeric variables with declared distribution summary need

reusable_core: detail 옵션의 estpost summarize 결과를 active 상태로 남긴다.
generality_rationale_ko: 분포 통계가 명시된 경우에만 같은 최소 상태 전이를 제공한다.
review_notes: Do not select when the requested output is only count/mean/sd or a durable shared summary dataset.

research_situations: a table needs a declared count, mean, and standard deviation layout retained as an estpost result
selection_conditions: the statistic set count/mean/sd is declared
a downstream esttab consumer is requested and no shared summary .dta is required
required_changes: replace the variable list and explicitly declared statistics only
tradeoffs: makes the table statistic layout explicit
cannot silently add groups, weights, or a durable dataset
reusable_core: count·mean·sd를 columns(statistics) 배열의 estpost tabstat 결과로 남긴다.
generality_rationale_ko: 통계와 배열을 명시하므로 esttab 형식화 전에 통계 계약을 좁게 고정한다.
review_notes: Use only when the selected table interface consumes estpost tabstat output.

research_situations: a declared two-group mean-comparison table is needed before esttab formatting
selection_conditions: the outcome and a genuinely two-valued grouping variable are declared
the group comparison is descriptive and a compatible estpost consumer is requested
required_changes: replace outcome and binary grouping variable only
tradeoffs: keeps the two-group comparison explicit
does not validate causal comparability or support more than two groups

produces: one active estpost two-group comparison result

template_input_profile.record_unit: one analysis observation assigned to one of two declared groups

reusable_core: 명시한 두 집단 간 outcome 평균 비교를 active estpost 결과로 남긴다.
generality_rationale_ko: 두 집단이라는 전제와 출력 상태를 숨기지 않는 원자 명령이다.
review_notes: Never infer a treatment/control grouping or claim causal balance from this descriptive command.

research_situations: the active e-class estimate needs a declared in-memory eststo name for a following esttab table
selection_conditions: a compatible active e-class estimate exists
the estimate name and its later table role are declared
required_changes: replace the declared estimate name only
tradeoffs: keeps table handoff name visible
is session-local and not a durable .ster save
reusable_core: active e-class 추정치를 선언한 eststo 이름으로 보관한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 명명만 수행하는 상태 전이로, 추정과 표 export를 결합하지 않는다.
review_notes: Use .ster persistence separately when results must survive a new Stata session.

research_situations: one or more named compatible estimates must be exported as a CSV table without TeX
selection_conditions: the ordered estimate names, CSV path, replace role, and standard-error presentation are declared
the request explicitly permits CSV rather than the project's final Excel outreg2 assembly
required_changes: replace ordered estimate names, CSV path, and declared display options only
tradeoffs: provides an inspectable non-TeX package export
is not the final xlsx/outreg2 contract and does not reconstruct coefficients
source_specific_elements: model names and results path placeholders
reusable_core: 명명된 추정치 목록을 standard-error 포함 CSV esttab으로 내보낸다.
generality_rationale_ko: TeX 없이 명명된 estimate와 CSV 경로만 대체하는 표 export 원자다.
review_notes: Do not use for final Excel regression-table assembly, and never change csv to tex.

research_situations: one next source with a verified common schema must be appended while retaining source provenance
selection_conditions: master and using data have documented compatible variables and units
the append order and source-id meaning are declared
required_changes: replace using path and provenance variable name only after schema compatibility is verified
tradeoffs: retains a source indicator
does not establish schema compatibility or key uniqueness by itself

requires: one declared using dataset with verified shared schema
produces: one combined active dataset with source-id indicator

template_input_profile.record_unit: one row from either declared source

source_specific_elements: temporary using path and source_id placeholders
reusable_core: 검증된 동일 schema의 using 자료를 append하고 source-id 변수를 생성한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 한 source append와 출처 표지만 수행하며 schema·key 검증을 별도 선행조건으로 보존한다.
review_notes: Preflight schema and key checks are mandatory; this atom must not be selected for incompatible row units.

research_situations: one declared categorical variable needs a visible frequency audit including missing values
selection_conditions: the categorical variable and the reason for inspecting missingness are declared
tradeoffs: keeps missing values visible
is a diagnostic display and does not repair or drop observations

variable_characteristics: categorical variable with potentially informative missingness

reusable_core: missing을 포함해 하나의 범주형 변수 분포를 tabulate로 진단한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 데이터 변경 없이 한 변수의 범주와 결측을 보이는 최소 진단이다.
review_notes: Do not treat displayed counts as a post-cleaning validation without separately declaring the target sample.

research_situations: two declared categorical variables need a row-percentage cross-tabulation audit
selection_conditions: both categorical variables and the diagnostic purpose are declared
cell support will be inspected before any chi-square interpretation
a chi-square display is requested as descriptive evidence rather than causal proof
required_changes: replace the two categorical variables only
tradeoffs: makes row composition visible
does not substitute for a model or validate sparse-cell assumptions

template_input_profile.record_unit: one active-data observation classified on two categorical dimensions

reusable_core: 두 범주형 변수의 row percentage와 chi-square 진단을 표시한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 두 변수와 표시 방식만 명시적으로 바꾸는 비파괴적 진단이다.
review_notes: Inspect cell support before interpreting chi-square output.

research_situations: a declared analysis-variable set needs a non-destructive missingness overview
selection_conditions: the variable list is declared and no imputation or deletion action is requested
required_changes: replace the declared variable list only
tradeoffs: surfaces missingness without changing data
does not diagnose the missing-data mechanism
reusable_core: 선언된 분석변수의 결측 현황을 misstable summarize로 진단한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 변수 목록 이외의 변경이 없고 자료를 변형하지 않는 결측 진단이다.
review_notes: Missingness remediation requires a separate declared method and must not be inferred from this output.

research_situations: a declared linear model uses one absorbed fixed effect and clustered standard errors
selection_conditions: outcome, treatment, controls, absorbed identifier, and cluster identifier are declared
the intended estimator is a one-absorbed-effect linear model
required_changes: replace outcome, treatment, controls, absorbed effect, and cluster only
tradeoffs: keeps the absorbed effect and cluster visible
does not establish whether the chosen FE or cluster level is substantively valid

requires: declared outcome treatment controls absorbed effect and cluster
produces: one active e-class absorbed-FE linear estimate

template_input_profile.record_unit: one observation within a declared absorbed-effect and cluster structure

source_specific_elements: outcome treatment controls entity_id cluster_id placeholders
reusable_core: 한 absorbed fixed effect와 명시 cluster를 포함한 areg 추정을 실행한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 추정식 핵심 구성요소를 모두 드러내며 표 저장·export는 분리한다.
review_notes: Selection is conditional on the declared estimator, FE, and cluster design; run post-estimation separately.

research_situations: a declared 2SLS design has one endogenous treatment, one excluded instrument, and clustered inference
selection_conditions: outcome, endogenous treatment, excluded instrument, controls, and cluster are declared
the IV identifying assumptions have been separately justified
required_changes: replace outcome, controls, endogenous treatment, instrument, and cluster only
tradeoffs: uses Stata's official IV command with the first-stage relation visible
syntax cannot establish relevance, exclusion, or weak-IV robustness

requires: declared outcome endogenous treatment instrument controls and cluster

source_specific_elements: outcome treatment instrument controls cluster placeholders
reusable_core: 한 endogenous treatment와 instrument를 명시한 ivregress 2sls를 실행한다.
generality_rationale_ko: IV 역할을 괄호 안에 그대로 보존하고 식별 가정은 선택 조건으로 분리한다.
review_notes: Use only after IV design review; first-stage and weak-IV diagnostics remain separate required checks.

research_situations: a declared 2SLS design specifically requests ivreg2 first-stage reporting and clustered inference
selection_conditions: ivreg2 is explicitly selected
outcome, endogenous treatment, instrument, controls, and cluster are declared
required_changes: replace outcome, controls, endogenous treatment, instrument, and cluster only
tradeoffs: requests the package's first-stage reporting
requires installed ivreg2 and does not establish IV validity

requires: declared ivreg2 method and IV roles
produces: one active ivreg2 e-class estimate with requested first-stage output

source_specific_elements: outcome treatment instrument controls cluster placeholders
reusable_core: ivreg2의 first-stage 표시와 cluster를 명시한 한 개 IV 추정을 실행한다.
generality_rationale_ko: ivreg2를 명시적으로 요청한 경우에만 official ivregress 대안과 분리해 선택한다.
review_notes: Do not select merely because an IV model exists; package availability and design diagnostics require separate target checks.

research_situations: the active compatible model needs predicted margins at explicitly declared focal-variable values
selection_conditions: a compatible active estimation result exists
the focal variable and all requested values are declared
required_changes: replace focal variable and explicit value list only
tradeoffs: preserves the requested comparison grid
interpretation depends on the immediately preceding estimator and covariate handling

template_input_profile.record_unit: one active estimate evaluated at each declared focal value
template_input_profile.time_structure: declared focal values may be time values
variable_characteristics: declared focal variable and comparison grid

reusable_core: active model에서 선언한 focal variable 값에 대한 margins를 계산한다.
generality_rationale_ko: 모형 다음의 한 상태 전이로만 사용하며 comparison grid를 숨기지 않는다.
review_notes: The command must immediately follow the compatible estimator; do not infer at() values.

research_situations: an immediately preceding margins result needs an active line and confidence-area graph
selection_conditions: a compatible margins result is immediately active
line and confidence-area geometry are requested
required_changes: replace only explicitly declared graph options
tradeoffs: keeps point and confidence rendering explicit
does not export a file or establish labels and axes not declared here
reusable_core: active margins 결과를 line과 rarea 신뢰구간의 active graph로 그린다.
generality_rationale_ko: margins result를 즉시 소비하는 graph 상태 전이이며 PDF export를 별도 계약으로 남긴다.
review_notes: Use figures.export_pdf separately and add labels/axis choices only when independently declared.

research_situations: a declared coefficient needs wild-bootstrap inference with an explicit cluster, replications, and seed
selection_conditions: boottest is explicitly selected
the active compatible estimate, tested null, coefficient, cluster, replications, and seed are declared
required_changes: replace coefficient, tested null, cluster, replication count, and seed only
tradeoffs: makes simulation reproducibility visible
does not establish that the bootstrap design is appropriate

requires: declared coefficient null cluster replications and seed
produces: one boottest inference result for the declared coefficient and null

reusable_core: 명시한 coefficient에 대해 cluster·reps·seed를 공개한 boottest를 실행한다.
generality_rationale_ko: bootstrap method를 명시 요청한 경우에만 필요한 재현성 binding을 모두 드러낸다.
review_notes: Do not select without a pre-specified bootstrap design and a compatible active estimate.

research_situations: a named Stata matrix must be placed in a declared first or replaceable Excel sheet
selection_conditions: the matrix exists
workbook path, sheet name, and replace role are declared
required_changes: replace workbook path, sheet name, matrix name, and overwrite role only
tradeoffs: preserves matrix row and column names
does not create a matrix or safely append to an undeclared existing sheet

produces: one declared Excel sheet containing the named matrix

template_input_profile.record_unit: one named matrix cell with row and column labels
variable_characteristics: declared workbook sheet and overwrite role

source_specific_elements: results path Summary sheet and summary_matrix placeholders
reusable_core: 명명된 matrix를 names와 함께 선언한 Excel sheet에 putexcel로 쓴다.
generality_rationale_ko: matrix 생성과 workbook ownership을 분리해 명시된 matrix export만 수행한다.
review_notes: Use only for a new or explicitly replaceable workbook/sheet; do not infer later-sheet semantics.

research_situations: an already populated Stata collection must be exported to a declared xlsx destination
selection_conditions: a nonempty compatible Stata collection is already active
the workbook path and replace role are declared
required_changes: replace the output path and declared overwrite role only
tradeoffs: uses Stata's existing collection without manual row reconstruction
does not build or style a collection

produces: one xlsx export of the active collection

template_input_profile.record_unit: one already populated Stata collection cell

reusable_core: 이미 채워진 Stata collection을 선언한 xlsx 경로로 collect export한다.
generality_rationale_ko: collection 조립과 export를 분리해 빈 collection 또는 자동 formatting을 만들지 않는다.
review_notes: This is for existing collection state only; table/dtable/etable construction must be selected separately.
